recentItems.title: DEEPEST STRIKE EVER! Yamal attacked as new FP-9 ballistic missiles will target MOSCOW this year
recentItems.description:
A historic record for Ukraine’s Armed Forces: Ukrainian drones travelled more than 3,200 km and completely destroyed two strategic gas facilities on the Yamal Peninsula — the Kremlin’s main energy lifeline.

Moscow’s nightmare is only beginning: the CEO of Fire Point has announced that the new Ukrainian FP-9 ballistic missile is ready. It is capable of striking targets deep inside Russia as early as this year.

Meanwhile, Volodymyr Zelenskyy has arrived in Canada for crucial talks on urgently strengthening air defence and protecting Ukraine’s energy infrastructure ahead of winter.

recentItems.title: UKRAINE STRIKES MANGUST PATROL BOAT, EW SYSTEM, and drone launch site hit near DONETSK!
recentItems.description:
The Defence Forces of Ukraine have carried out a series of precise and damaging strikes on key strategic facilities belonging to the Russian occupiers in Crimea and Donbas.

In temporarily occupied Sevastopol, a Project Mangust fast patrol boat was hit. The occupiers used it for patrols and sabotage missions. A valuable enemy electronic intelligence (ELINT) system was also put out of action. Meanwhile, near occupied Donetsk, Ukrainian forces destroyed a large facility used to store, prepare, and launch enemy attack drones, disrupting new waves of aerial terror.

recentItems.title: DID THE DICTATOR DECEIVE EVERYONE AGAIN! Moscowʼs real plans for 2027 revealed!
recentItems.description:
The Kremlin’s diplomatic charade has completely failed: the United States and Europe have deemed their latest contacts with Putin fruitless and are preparing for a prolonged war lasting at least until 2027.

According to Bloomberg, the dictator has rejected any concessions and plans to intensify attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure as much as possible this winter in an attempt to break the civilian population.

Moscow’s talk of being “ready for peace” turned out to be nothing more than a smokescreen for stockpiling missiles and regrouping forces. How will Ukraine’s allies respond to the aggressor’s long-term plan? Watch our analysis to find out!
